page: UpCloud GPU-20xCPU-256GB-3xL4 is an x86_64 architecture server powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 20 shared vCPUs and 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 12.8 GB per vCPU. The server does not include local storage, meaning external block storage must be attached for persistent data. It comes provisioned with one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The defining characteristic of this server is its integrated graphics processing hardware. It is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This multi-GPU configuration is designed to accelerate parallel computing tasks, machine learning workloads, and graphics rendering without relying solely on the shared CPU resources.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a dense allocation of GPU and memory resources relative to its 20 shared vCPUs. This makes it a specialized option for workloads that require significant GPU memory and system RAM but do not demand dedicated, non-shared CPU cores. Appropriate workloads include medium-scale AI and deep learning inference, data science pipelines, video transcoding, and parallelized scientific simulations.
